explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/441: 'Erdős [Er51b] proved g(N) ≤ (4N)^{1/2} + O(1)', where g(N) is the largest size of A ⊆ {1,…,N} with all pairwise lcms ≤ N. The Lean variant ∃ C, ∀ N, g N ≤ √(4N) + C is exactly this with a uniform O(1) constant; g N is the sSup of attainable sizes (bounded by N), i.e. the maximum. Faithful.
